title: Goofy Ahh
blurb: Nobody can quite define goofy ahh, and that is rather the point. It is an entire editing aesthetic compressed into a noise: cartoon-adjacent, over-compressed, and aimed exclusively at things that consider themselves serious. The phrase grew out of the internet's habit of bolting 'ahh' onto any adjective — goofy ahh, weird ahh, ugly ahh — and this clip became the audio stamp for the whole genre. Drop it over a motivational speech, a gym transformation video or somebody's LinkedIn announcement, and watch the gravity drain out of the room. Maximum silliness applied to minimum situations, every single time.
origin: From the 'goofy ahh' meme wave — cartoonish sounds applied to overly serious clips.
